title: Senior Automation Engineer – Commissioning
description:
**Location:** Kochi, Nagpur

**Openings:** 1

**Experience:** 4+ years in commissioning of industrial automation/control systems, within that 2+ years in a supervisory or lead capacity

**Position Overview:**

The Senior Automation Engineer – Commissioning is a senior field role responsible for end-to-end execution of industrial automation and control system projects at client sites. The role spans pre-commissioning through final handover, covering PLC/SCADA systems, Substation Automation, industrial networking, IIoT and OT Cybersecurity Systems. The incumbent leads a team of site engineers and technicians, serves as the primary technical escalation point on site, and ensures projects are delivered safely, on schedule, and to specification.

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead, plan, and allocate commissioning work across site engineers for concurrent project deployments.

* Plan commissioning schedules, resource mobilisation, and site readiness activities in coordination with Project Managers.

* Supervise on-site activities: panel installation, cable laying, terminations, and equipment setup.

* Lead I/O wiring verification and loop checks between PLCs and field devices.

* Review, download, configure, and validate PLC and HMI/SCADA programs as per project specifications.

* Lead execution of interlock testing and logic validation as per FDS; function as senior escalation point for PLC/SCADA troubleshooting on site.

* Configure and test communication protocols: Modbus RTU/TCP, Profibus, Profinet, Ethernet/IP, MQTT, OPC UA.

* Lead Substation Automation System (SAS) commissioning activities including configuration and testing of IEDs, RTUs, and bay controllers per IEC 61850 standards.

* Configure and test IEC 104 communication links between substation RTUs/gateways and SCADA/control centres.

* Commission and validate industrial network infrastructure: managed Ethernet switches, VLANs, ring topologies (HSR/PRP/RSTP), and fiber optic backbones.

* Enforce OT Cybersecurity controls on site in alignment with IEC 62443 – including network segmentation, DMZ architecture, firewall rules, access control, patch management, and endpoint protection.

* Coordinate with cybersecurity team for deployment and validation of OT security tools (Claroty, Cisco ISE, Palo Alto, Acronis, or equivalent).

* Coordinate with the Engineering team for resolution of site-raised design issues and Technical Queries (TQs).

* Lead FAT and SAT execution; oversee punch-list closure and commissioning documentation sign-off.

* Manage Control System AMC activities: system inspections, preventive maintenance, and repairs.

* Ensure all commissioning documentation is prepared, reviewed, and handed over: pre-commissioning checklists, SAT reports, site work plans, and as-built markups.

* Enforce compliance with safety regulations, permit-to-work (PTW) procedures, and quality standards on site.

* Mentor and guide junior automation engineers and site technicians; conduct performance reviews and recommend training actions.

* Act as the primary client interface on site for technical discussions, progress updates, and issue resolution.

**Must Have Requirements:**

* Degree in Electrical & Electronics, Electronics & Instrumentation, Electronics & Communication, Mechatronics, or related field.

* 4+ years of experience in commissioning of industrial automation/control systems, with 2+ years in a supervisory or lead capacity.

* Proficiency in configuring, programming, and troubleshooting PLCs, HMIs, and SCADA systems.

* Hands-on experience with Rockwell Automation, Siemens, Schneider Electric, or similar platforms.

* Experience in Process Industries shall be given preference.

* Strong understanding of field instrument integration (pressure, level, flow, temperature) with PLC/SCADA systems.

* Proficiency in PLC programming languages: Ladder Logic (LD), Structured Text (ST), and Function Block Diagram (FBD).

* Experience with industrial communication protocols: Modbus RTU/TCP, Profibus, Profinet, Ethernet/IP.

* Hands-on experience with IEC 61850 engineering tools for IED configuration.

* Experience commissioning IEC 104 telecontrol links between RTUs/gateways and SCADA systems.

* Practical knowledge of industrial network commissioning: managed switches, VLAN configuration, HSR/PRP/RSTP redundancy, and fiber optic communication.

* Ability to read and interpret GA drawings, wiring diagrams, Loop Drawings, SLDs, and P&IDs.

* Experience in leading FAT/SAT execution and commissioning documentation sign-off.

* Working knowledge of hazardous area classification (ATEX/IECEx) and safety practices on O&G sites.

* Willingness to travel extensively and work at remote project locations.

* Strong leadership, problem-solving, documentation, and client communication skills.

**Good to Have Requirements:**

* Knowledge of integrating PLCs with MCCs, PCCs, and electrical switchgear systems.

* Familiarity with IIoT protocols: MQTT, OPC UA, and REST APIs.

* Knowledge of communication media: Ethernet, RS232, RS485, and Fiber Optics.

* Exposure to OT Cybersecurity frameworks (IEC 62443) with practical experience in network segmentation, firewall configuration, and secure remote access implementation.

* Familiarity with OT security tools: Claroty, Nozomi, Palo Alto, Cisco ISE, or equivalent.

* Working knowledge of additional telecontrol/SCADA protocols: DNP3, IEC 101, or IEC 103.

* Exposure to Functional Safety (IEC 61511/SIL) on O&G commissioning projects.

**Natural Talent & Personality Fit:**

Beyond skills and experience, the right candidate is someone who is naturally wired for this role:

* Stays calm and thinks clearly under site pressure – failed loop checks, comm faults, or client escalations don’t derail them.

* Takes personal ownership of project outcomes; spots problems early and acts without being prompted.

* Manages up to clients and down to technicians with equal ease, fairness, and respect.

* Has strong engineering instinct – can walk onto an unfamiliar panel and quickly form a working hypothesis.

* Communicates with precision; translates complex site issues into clear briefings, TQs, and client reports.

* Leads by presence and competence, not just designation – earns respect through conduct and expertise.

* Genuinely curious about how integrated systems work – reads beyond the immediate scope, asks the right questions.

* Comfortable working in remote, multicultural, and demanding site environments for extended periods.

**Why Join CONSYST:**

Step into a leadership role at Consyst, where we empower our senior engineers to make a real impact through:

* **Talent Cultivation:** We invest in your growth, offering structured development programs, cross-domain exposure, and a clear path to senior leadership.

* **Innovative Projects:** Lead cutting-edge PLC, SCADA, Substation Automation, and OT Cybersecurity commissioning projects for leading Oil & Gas clients.

* **Dynamic Team Environment:** Lead a collaborative team where your decisions drive project success and company growth.

If you’re ready to take the lead and make a lasting impact, seize the moment and apply today! Elevate your career with Consyst – where your potential meets limitless possibilities!
